mapper.select: select r.`id`, r.`target_type`, r.`target_id`, r.`reporter_id`, r.`report_reason`, r.`report_type`, r.`status`, r.`handler_note`, r.`create_time`, r.`update_time`, case when r.target_type = 1 then bc.comment_content else bcr.reply_content end as targetContent, u1.username as reporterName, case when r.target_type = 1 then u2.username else u3.username end as commenterName from comment_report r left join book_comment bc on r.target_type = 1 and r.target_id = bc.id left join book_comment_reply bcr on r.target_type = 2 and r.target_id = bcr.id left join user u1 on r.reporter_id = u1.id left join user u2 on bc.create_user_id = u2.id left join user u3 on bcr.create_user_id = u3.id where r.id = #{value}
mapper.delete:
delete from comment_report where id in
#{id}
